customer_segment: Individual consumers who want to discover and evaluate beauty products (often before committing to full-size purchases) via samples and retail channels
end_activity: Repurchase a preferred full-size product (or switch/exit and restart discovery for a new product need)

activities.activity: Recognize a need or desire to try a new beauty product (e.g., skincare, makeup, haircare)
activities.customer_goal: Decide what category/problem to address and whether to look for something new

activities.current_provider: Brick-and-mortar beauty retailers and major beauty brands (in-store displays/advertising/word-of-mouth) and Birchbox (curated monthly discovery)
activities.customer_goal: Generate a short list of promising products to consider without spending excessive time searching

activities.activity: Evaluate products by trying them before buying full-size
activities.current_provider: Beauty retailers (in-store testing) and Birchbox (at-home sample trial via delivered boxes)
activities.customer_goal: Reduce uncertainty about fit (shade, feel, results) and avoid wasting money on the wrong full-size product

activities.current_provider: Beauty retailers and brands (in-store or online purchasing)
activities.customer_goal: Acquire the chosen product in the right size/variant at an acceptable price and convenience

activities.activity: Use the product at home and assess satisfaction over time
activities.customer_goal: Achieve the desired beauty outcome and confirm the product is worth continuing

activities.activity: Repurchase favorites (and restart discovery/evaluation when needs change)
activities.current_provider: Beauty retailers and brands (store/online) and the customer’s own routine
activities.customer_goal: Maintain a reliable set of products while minimizing future search and trial effort

profile_vs_cvc_conflicts: The company profile centers Birchbox as the solution for discovery/evaluation, but the customer value chain shows that full-size purchase and repurchase are typically completed through retailers/brands (not the subscription box itself), meaning Birchbox addresses only a subset of the end-to-end job-to-be-done (E8, E10, E11, E12).
